MASTER CALENDAR JURY
Off Calendar Aug-14-2003 Vacated

MANDATORY SETTLEMENT CONFERENCE
Off Calendar Aug-14-2003 Off Calendar
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for hearing this day.
PTJ: Anne Hipshman, CSR: Patricia Van Steenberge, Clerk: Marta Vallejo
Appearances:
Ross Holley through his Attorney, James M. Millar
Curtis Saunders, Defendant present in pro per.
Parties met in chambers and reached a settlement by stipulation.
Terms of the ORAL settlement were read into the record as follows:
Plaintiff is entitled to a future judgment against the defendant for restitution and possession of the premises of the property located at: 589 Haight St., 2nd. Fl., SF
If the defendant vacates the premises on or before August 24, 2003, plaintiff waives all back rent damages. Plaintiff to Pay $500.00 to Defendant upon tender of the keys, at Mr. Millar's office and will file a dismissal within 5 days of the keys return. Security deposit to be retain by Plaintiff.
Each party waives claim against the other.
Each to bears its own costs and attorney's fees.
Any items left in the premises will be disposed of.
If defendant did not comply with the agreement, plaintiff may so state by ex parte application and declaration have judgment entered for Back rent in the amount of $1,500.00 (Amount set by stipulation) plus Costs.
Defendant waives any right to make a motion to set aside or vacate the judgment, or to apply for a stay or relief from forfeiture.
All parties agreed to the settlement in open court.
The Court deemed the matter settled and trial date is vacated.
